speech.heard: USA has 13.6 tons per person, Dr. Congo sits at 0.057. Qatar hits 47.3 tons, one of the highest on Earth. Kuwait sits at 23.7, and Oman hits 18.7. USA has 13.6, and China has 9.32. Somalia stays down at 0.046. It counts total annual emissions of carbon dioxide from agriculture, energy, waste, and industrial sectors divided by the population. How much carbon does your nation emit per person?
